cue: A new check is red on the current commit, and it is tempting to call it a false alarm.
lesson: Look at the page as a person sees it before tuning the check: the first red of a new check is often a real escape.
evidence: aip-31df: c1's first run on the current commit was red on three docs slides at 390 px; a screenshot showed the page really scrolled 13 to 43 px sideways, and the docs app was fixed (8115ed0).
